title: feat(ui): a page's api-bound elements read again after its own action succeeds
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbX7oJDEEKRN3bmGTKq3nxt9)_

Fixes #31891

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:页面上绑定 `api` 数据源的元素,在同一页面的动作成功后会重新读一次接口,显示写入后的新数据;读取期间旧数据留在屏上不闪加载态,重读失败显示该绑定的错误面板。
- **为什么改**:云端 AI 员工页每行的「停用 / 重新启用」按钮点了之后行不变,只能弹「请重新打开页面」的提示(cloud#4086);原因是这类元素只在打开页面时读一次,动作后的刷新信号到不了它。
- **风险与回滚**:只在页面自己的动作成功后重读;失败、取消确认或参数框、`refreshAfter: false` 以及应用里其他地方的写入都不触发,不会每次全局变动都重读。不改 `@objectstack/spec`,SDUI 清单不动。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/react/src/element-data-source/useElementApiDataSource.ts`(`createElementApiReread`、`ElementApiRereadScope`、读取 effect 的 `generation` 依赖与 `askedThisEpoch`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx`(`declarePageDataChanged` 先发总线再 `reread()`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.apiElementReread-31891.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.apiElementReread-31891.test.tsx packages/react/src/element-data-source/__tests__/elementApiReread-31891.test.tsx`,预期两个文件全绿(5 + 3 个用例)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@object-ui/react`: a page-scoped re-read signal for `api`-bound elements.** `createElementApiReread()` makes a signal (`reread()`, `generation()`, `subscribe()`), and `ElementApiRereadScope` provides it. `useElementApiDataSource` reads the generation with `useSyncExternalStore` and adds it to its read effect's inputs, so a `reread()` makes every reader below the scope read again, and no reader outside it does.
  - The generation is not part of the settled answer's key, so while the new read is in flight the hook keeps answering `ready` with the last answer. `SchemaRenderer` never draws the loading panel, and whatever the element holds (the row button in the middle of its own run) stays mounted. The new answer replaces it in place.
  - A failed re-read settles as `error`, so the binding's error face is drawn and the answer from before the write is not.
  - A read asked after `reread()` never joins a request that was in flight before it, and is never handed out again from the console's open (`askedThisEpoch`, a per-request epoch kept in a `WeakMap`). Readers that ask after it still share one request. `ElementApiOpen`'s exported shape is unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`: the page's action refresh asks its elements to read again.** `PageView` makes one signal per mount (a `useState` initializer, so the refresh it hands the action runtime keeps one identity for the page's life). `declarePageDataChanged` first sends `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })` as before, which drops the console open's kept answers synchronously, and then calls `reread()`. `ElementApiRereadScope` wraps the page body inside `ConsoleActionRuntimeProvider`.
- **Trigger choice (the card's item 2): option (a), scoped to the page.** No spec key was added. `refreshAfter` already decides whether a handler calls the page's `onRefresh`.
- **Docs:** one paragraph each in `ui/packages/react/README.md` ("useElementApiDataSource — the API binding") and `content/docs/frontend/data-source.mdx` (after the `ElementApiOpenScope` paragraph). The seat added both files to the surface.
- **No `@objectstack/spec` change.** The SDUI manifest does not move (`node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0).

### Which paths reach the trigger (measured at `6a8f4151`)

The page's `onRefresh` has one caller: a console action handler's success branch, through `useConsoleActionRuntime`'s `refresh`.
- The `api` handler calls it on the declared door, the direct same-origin call and the dataSource path.
- The `flow` handler calls it when `judgeFlowLaunch` answers `done`, and `FlowRunner`'s `onComplete` calls it for a run that paused at a screen and then completed.
- The `script` handler calls it through core `createServerActionHandler` (`operation: 'update'` or `refreshAfter !== false`).
- A refused or failed answer returns before that call. So does every early return in `ActionRunner.execute`: a false `condition`, a `disabled` gate, `refuseBeforeInput`, a cancelled confirmation and a cancelled param dialog.
- An inline `action:button` forwards `refreshAfter` from its props, where the spec declares it optional with no default, so all three executors refresh unless the author writes `false`.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.apiElementReread-31891.test.tsx` (new, five cases). It uses the real `PageView`, the console action runtime and `action:button`, under the console's `ElementApiOpenScope`. The page has one element bound to `GET /api/v1/reread-probe/workers` with a row `api` button inside it. The GETs are the element reader's and the POST is the runtime's authenticated fetch, counted apart.
  1. A successful click makes exactly one more GET. The rows and the same button node stay on screen with no loading panel while it is in flight, the new answer renders, and the element keeps its instance.
  2. A failed POST makes no GET.
  3. A cancelled `confirmText` sends no POST and makes no GET.
  4. `'*'` and an object change declared on the bus make no GET.
  5. A failed re-read draws the binding's error face and not the old rows.
- `ui/packages/react/src/element-data-source/__tests__/elementApiReread-31891.test.tsx` (new, three cases, through `SchemaRenderer`):
  - `reread()` makes one more GET, keeps the old answer on screen while it is in flight, and renders the new answer in place.
  - A request in flight at `reread()` is not joined, and its late answer does not overwrite the newer one.
  - Control: a reader outside the scope does not read again, and a bus change alone reads nothing.
- **Ablation** (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `reread.reread();` deleted from `PageView.tsx`): case 1 went red with "The bound element did not read again after the page action succeeded.: expected 1 to be 2", and case 5 went red. Cases 2–4 (which assert absences) stayed green. The tool restored the file: blob after restore `9088f4dd` equals the blob at HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Boundary (seat ruling 3): writes through a runtime nested in the page do not re-read the page's `api` elements.** These include an embedded `ObjectView` with its own `useConsoleActionRuntime`, a record drawer's save (a dataSource write, which reaches only the bus), and a flow run from the console-wide runtime (`ConsoleShell`'s `GlobalActionRuntimeProvider`, whose `onRefresh` is unset). The card scopes the trigger to the page's own actions.
- **Navigation `visible` gates are left out.** `useNavMemberGates` calls `readElementApi` directly, outside the page, and does not read again after a page action.
- The epoch is module-wide. A `reread()` on one page makes a concurrent reader elsewhere that asks in the same window send its own request instead of joining one asked before the re-read. That costs at most one extra request and never serves stale data.
- cloud#4086's buttons were not read (the cloud repo is unreadable from this account). They re-read as long as they do not write `refreshAfter: false`.
